prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Twin Column Customization Studio: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen into a two-column interactive studio layout with dynamic preview and formatting guidance. (why: The adoption stage drops to 74.7% conversion with high mean duration (1017s), and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or visual errors.)
1: [home, layout] Centered Minimal Waiting Room Experience: Redesign the waiting screen into a centered layout featuring an animated pet mascot and progress tracker. (why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, creating hesitation where 16.4% of users drop off.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Switch Pet Retention Guarantee Notice: Display an explicit account safety notice on the sign-in screen reassuring users that logging in will preserve and merge existing desktop pet data. (why: 8 support emails (the top support issue) complained about pets missing or reset after signing in.)
3: [choose_path, reorder] Story First Welcome Flow Restructure: Restructure the onboarding order to present the interactive story scroll before choosing a pet adoption path. (why: Choose path has an unusually high mean duration of 514s; establishing emotional story context first helps users make quicker adoption path decisions.)
4: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Badge Seal Preview: Add an official digital wax seal badge and companion preview card to the adoption certificate screen to increase ownership satisfaction. (why: Adoption has the lowest completion rate in the mid-funnel (74.7%), taking median 89s to complete.)
5: [finish, redesign] Stage Layout Companion Arrival Celebration: Transform the home intro screen into a stage layout with a celebration sound effect and arrival checklist. (why: Finish conversion drops to 71.7% with a mean duration of 5815s; a celebratory layout provides clear closure and prompts immediate desktop deployment.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Background Spawn Audio Notification Switch: Enable desktop notification toggle and audio prompt on the waiting screen when asset rendering finishes. (why: Waiting step mean duration is 2336s, showing users leave the desktop app running in the background while waiting.)
